notes_for_editor: Thin record. The Texas table is the only source for the c1936 build year and its 100-foot height; the NGS description gives 110 feet, and the brief's 33.5 m matches the NGS figure, so it is kept. No source gives a removal year (the table shows Unk). No source describes public access or what remains at the site, so access is omitted. No staffing or fire sources found. Two WebSearch calls were used; neither turned up removal records. The NGS page's 'CHAMBER HILL' spelling is the survey's own. No photos added: the ScholarWorks record gave no image URL.
